how_to_apply: Eligible candidates must apply through the official UPSSSC website between 6 November and 27 November 2026. Authentication is completed using PET 2025 registration details.
Visit the official UPSSSC website at https://upsssc.gov.in/.
Select Advertisement No. 25-Exam/2026 for the Combined Junior Engineer (Electrical) Main Examination.
Read the complete recruitment notification and eligibility requirements.
Click Apply Online and authenticate using the PET 2025 Registration Number.
Complete OTP verification using the registered mobile number or email address.
Review the personal details retrieved from PET 2025.
Select the posts for which you satisfy the required educational qualification and age conditions.
Enter the educational qualification, certificate and other requested details.
Verify the photograph, signature and application information.
Complete the declaration and submit the application.
Pay the online processing fee of Rs. 25.
Ensure successful payment adjustment and final submission.
Download and print the completed application form for future reference.
Important: Candidates must select every post for which they wish to be considered. The Commission will not consider candidates for posts that they have not selected in the application form.

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC JE Electrical Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: UPSSSC has announced the online registration, fee payment and application correction schedule for the Combined Junior Engineer Electrical Main Examination 2026. Candidates must complete the online application and fee payment within the prescribed dates. Important: Applications and fresh fee payments will not be accepted after 27 November 2026. Candidates must complete fee adjustment by 4 December 2026 to obtain the application printout and use the permitted correction facility.

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC JE Electrical Vacancy 2026 Department-wise Details
content_sections.text: The official notification advertises 380 vacancies across 16 department-wise recruitment entries. The largest share is in the Uttar Pradesh Public Works Department, with 231 Junior Engineer (Electrical) posts. Other vacancies are available in the Directorate of Electrical Safety, UPSRTC, government corporations and universities. Public Works Department: 231 Junior Engineer (Electrical) vacancies. UPSRTC: 56 Electrician vacancies. UP Rajkiya Nirman Nigam: 46 Junior Engineer (Electrical) vacancies, including special selection. Directorate of Electrical Safety: 34 Junior Engineer (Electrical) vacancies, including special selection. UP State Construction and Infrastructure Development Corporation: 4 Junior Engineer (Electrical) vacancies. The notification also provides vertical and horizontal reservation details. content_sections.heading: UPSSSC JE Electrical Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must have participated in UPSSSC Preliminary Eligibility Test (PET) 2025. A PET 2025 scorecard must have been issued by the Commission. Main examination shortlisting will be based on normalized PET 2025 scores. Candidates with zero or negative absolute or normalized PET scores will not be shortlisted for the main examination. Candidates whose PET 2025 results are marked Provisional or Under Investigation may apply provisionally, subject to the Commission's final decision. Qualification Cut-off Date: Candidates must possess the required essential qualifications and relevant supporting certificates by 27 November 2026. Qualifications must satisfy the service rules applicable to the selected department. Equivalent technical qualifications are governed by the recognition orders included with the notification. For various posts, candidates who have served at least two years in the Territorial Army or possess an NCC 'B' Certificate may receive preference when other recruitment conditions are equal. Candidates should verify special-selection eligibility before selecting those posts.
